verdict.rationale: Gram is positioned as a governance/control-plane layer for MCP servers, tool catalogs, RBAC, and observability, not as an automation/scheduling engine that runs agent tasks autonomously in the background; skills (SKILL.md) are on-demand instructions loaded by agents, not autonomous background jobs. No evidence of scheduled tasks, triggers, or standalone background execution loops. missing for 10: any documentation of scheduled/triggered automations, background job execution, or autonomous run capability independent of a live agent session.
